messages:
zoe: Hi team — AcmePay called out a firm commit for dedicated capacity. They've asked for a sizing recommendation and answers for their security folks. They want 300–400 QPS peak for chat and ~60 QPS for embeddings, expected 95% of traffic at short prompts. Can we sketch a plan?
liam: Congrats. Do we have an expected token profile? short prompts ~= 40 tokens in, 80 tokens out average?
zoe: Yes — they sent a sample: median prompt 35 tokens, median response 90 tokens. Total daily active users ~50k, peak concentrated in 2 x 1-hour windows.
raj: Quick calc: 400 QPS * (35+90)=400*125=50k tokens/sec => 4.32B tokens/day if sustained 24h, but they only peak short windows. Need tail math.
liam: For reserved GPUs, suggest baseline reserved pool sized for 60% of peak sustained, plus burst credits for the rest. That minimizes cost while satisfying SLOs.
sarah: Can we propose a concrete fleet? e.g., 4x A10g-equivalent for baseline plus 2x A100-80GB prewarmed for bursts? We should quantify latency SLOs per model variant.
raj: Also propose quantized model variant (int8) for lower-cost fallback at ~20–30% lower throughput cost; runtime supports automatic fallback routing.
zoe: AcmePay asked about autoscale policy specifics and cold-starts — they want <150ms token latency 95th.
liam: Recommend continuous batching + prefix cache. Autoscale policy: scale up when 95th token latency >120ms for 30s, cooldown 180s; scale down after idle 5m. Prewarm slots: keep 2 warm workers of burst type in standby during business hours.
olivia: Add note: reserved pool must be in their VPC for Private deployment; KMS integration required for keys. Security team will ask about HSM support and audit logs.
zoe: They already handed our security questionnaire — red flags: SSO, KMS, and data residency. Someone from infra to answer the KMS/HSM bits?
raj: I'll draft responses. KMS: we support customer-managed KMS via AWS KMS and GCP KMS; HSM-backed keys supported for Private with HSM appliance — need ops-run. Audit logs: Console exports per-request logs with masking; retention tier is configurable.
liam: Pricing note for sales: show two price lanes — committed baseline (monthly reserved) priced per-GPU + usage for bursts; and an alternative fully-hosted blended price for simplicity. Provide cost-per-1M tokens for the baseline+burst mix.
sarah: For the POC we'll propose a 2-week stress test: synthetic traffic with 2x peak for 30min windows. Provide scripts and a quick smokeplaybook.
zoe: Can someone paste autoscale snippet we can give to Acme for review?
raj: Here — sample policy (yaml):
```
autoscale_policy:
  target_95th_latency_ms: 120
  evaluation_window_sec: 30
  scale_up_step: +1
  cooldown_sec: 180
  scale_down_idle_sec: 300
  prewarm_workers: 2
```
Use continuous batching and kv-prefix-caching=true
liam: I'll add a line explaining fallback: route to quantized-int8 model when queued latency > 150ms or when reserved pool CPU/GPU utilization > 85%.
olivia: Security QAs — request for SSO: we support SAML and OIDC, enforced SCIM provisioning for accounts. Ask if they require SCIM group sync.
zoe: Great. Action items — raj: fill security questionnaire answers and confirm HSM path; liam: produce cost numbers for baseline+burst and a blended option; sarah: POC plan + stress scripts; olivia: confirm SSO details and sample SAML metadata. I'll collate and send to Acme by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: New presales ticket created: PS-4321 assigned to zoe, liam, raj, sarah, olivia.
zoe: Thanks — ping me in the morning if you need details from the customer (they're time-zoned PST).
